gold.title: logic: macOS-specific sed syntax with empty string after -i flag will fail on Linux systems
gold.description: logic: macOS-specific sed syntax with empty string after -i flag will fail on Linux systems

candidate.title: Dev script writes .env outside the repo and exits 0 on failure
candidate.description: ENV_FILE path resolves to parent directory instead of repo root; cleanup() exits 0 on errors; sed -i '' is BSD-only and fails on Linux.

missed_correctness_gold.title: The updateManyByCredentialId call uses an empty data object, which prevents Prisma's @updatedAt decorator from updating
missed_correctness_gold.description: The updateManyByCredentialId call uses an empty data object, which prevents Prisma's @updatedAt decorator from updating the updatedAt timestamp. This results in inaccurate cache status tracking, as the timestamp isn't updated when the cache is refreshed. To fix this, explicitly set the updatedAt field.

promotion_candidates.title: "Delete cached data" is exposed on surfaces that explicitly disable connection modification
promotion_candidates.description: hasCache computed independently of disableConnectionModification; cache deletion action shown on surfaces that should prohibit connection changes. Also lacks onSettled invalidation on deleteCacheMutation.

promotion_candidates.title: Cache reads/deletes bypass CalendarCache.init() feature-flag factory, making the mock dead code
promotion_candidates.description: Direct CalendarCacheRepository instantiation bypasses feature-flag factory; mock for disabled flag is unreachable. deleteCache.handler also uses raw Prisma instead of repository pattern.

promotion_candidates.title: Dead SelectedCalendar.updatedAt plumbing writes on every webhook-driven cache refresh
promotion_candidates.description: Unconditional UPDATE across all SelectedCalendar rows on each webhook with unused results. Semantically incorrect; bumps rows not in refreshed set.

promotion_candidates.title: Cache timestamp is hardcoded to en-US inside a localized component
promotion_candidates.description: Intl.DateTimeFormat hardcoded to en-US ignores user locale; non-English users see US date/time format with translated labels.

promotion_candidates.title: Authorization denial in deleteCache throws a bare Error, surfacing as a 500
promotion_candidates.description: Plain Error instead of TRPCError for authorization denial; coerced to INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR instead of proper 4xx response. Triggers alerts on routine authz rejections.

promotion_candidates.title: Raw Tailwind gray classes instead of semantic tokens, flattening dark-mode hierarchy
promotion_candidates.description: Uses raw gray-900/gray-500 instead of semantic tokens (text-emphasis/text-subtle); dark:text-white override erases contrast between heading and secondary text.
